QuestInfo.name: Delivering the Test Subject's Medicine
QuestInfo.0: The Resistance's #b#p2151003##k has more to say. Could it be a mission? Talk to #p2151003# in the #bUnderground Base#k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2151003# says it isn't a secret mission, but a simple favor. She wants you to meet with a #bResistance secret agent#k to deliver some medicine. The new medicine appears to be something that was concocted by #p2151005#. Go to the Secret Meeting Place via the back alley near #m310030110#'s phone booth.
QuestInfo.2: The Resistance secret agent was #p2159010#, who rescued you in front of the Laboratory a long time ago! #p2159010# said that he's seen a lot of medicine with the initial 'V' on it and wondered who made the medicine.
